# RP Custom Labels

RP is a factory-direct custom label manufacturer for overseas B2B buyers.

Primary services:
- Custom peptide vial labels and research vial labels
- Custom supplement labels for vitamins, capsules, protein, gummies and wellness packaging
- Custom 3D holographic labels, QR security labels and anti-counterfeit stickers

Core buyer terms:
- MOQ starts from 100 pcs for many custom projects
- Free design support
- Free digital proof before production
- Sample lead time is usually 1-2 days after details are confirmed
- Bulk production is usually 10-12 days after proof approval
- Worldwide shipping support
